title: Quality: elite foot too
items: Elite Companies: new Heavy Infantry Power +10% and Light Infantry Power +10%, with Heavy Infantry Maintenance Cost +5% (the same as it gives cavalry)

title: Drilling is Leadership's now
items: Quality: description no longer speaks of drill; its morale advances are renamed Esprit de Corps (army) and Pride of the Fleet (navy), same effects
Leadership: description now names the drill sergeants and veteran training

title: Levy: many more knights
items: Enforced Service: Nobles Levy Size +30% → +200%

title: Leadership: better trained generals, faster drilling
items: Military Academies: Train General Ability +40 → +45, Train Admiral Ability +40 → +45
Drill Sergeants: Monthly Experience Gain +50% → +75%

title: Levy: more knights
items: Enforced Service: new Nobles Levy Size +30% (nobles raise the cavalry levies; the same bonus France gets from French Heritage)

title: Mercenary: cheaper upkeep
items: Benefits for Mercenaries: Mercenary Maintenance Efficiency +10% → +25%
Outside the focuses, mercenaries now cost what they do in the base game: the mod's higher hiring premium and prisoner hiring price are gone

title: Diplomatic: a stronger pick for conquest
items: Flexible Negotiation: new Peace Offer Negotiation Power +0.15
Formal Diplomacy: new Antagonism Decay +0.1
Diplomatic Influence: Diplomatic Capacity +1 → +2
Diplomatic Corps: new War with No Casus Belli Cost −25%
Indirect Rule: Speed of Integration +10% → +25%

title: Political Influence for the court and the cabinet
items: Dynamic Court (Court): new Political Influence Gain +10%
Integrated Elites (Influence): new Political Influence Gain +15%
Cabinet (Administration): new Monthly Political Influence +0.25

title: Updated for game version 1.4
items: Trained March and Unrelenting Advance: Army Morale Movement Cost −0.02% → −0.14%. The game made this modifier 7 times bigger in 1.4, so the old value had become almost nothing; this keeps the 1.3 strength
People's War: Prosperity Recovery +1% → +0.5%. In 1.4 the game halved every source of prosperity recovery; this keeps People's War at twice the usual advance, as on 1.3
National Trade Policy: Selling Efficiency +2.5% → +5%, the 1.4 game value for this advance
Privateers: now also unlocks the Letters of Marque policy, as it does in the 1.4 game
Smithian Economics: Production Efficiency +5% → +2.5%. The 1.4 game cut this value for everyone, and the focus pick follows it

title: Exploration: cheaper exploring and colonies
items: Quest for the New World: new Exploration Cost Efficiency +20%
Exploration Ideas: new Recruiting Explorers −25%
Fortune-Seekers: new Create Colonial Charter Cost −20%
Colonial Ventures: new Colonial Maintenance Efficiency +20%

title: Influence: subjects pay more
items: Tribute System: Subject Income +5% → +25%

title: Influence: stronger Buffer States
items: Buffer States: Diplomatic Capacity +1 → +2, Diplomatic Reputation +2 → +4

title: Influence: Integrated Elites curbs the estates
items: Integrated Elites: new Estates Power −20% (Monthly Diplomats and Max Diplomats unchanged)

title: Trade: advantage and range
items: Shrewd Commerce: Market Attraction +10% replaced by Trade Advantage +15%
Merchant Traditions: Trade Maritime Advantage +10% replaced by Trade Range +20%

title: Levy: bigger levies, faster recovery
items: Enforced Service: Levy Size +10% → +20%, Levy Recovery +10% → +20%

title: Leadership: slower experience decay
items: Drill Sergeants: Monthly Experience Decay −1% → −2%

title: Military redesign: no more naval-only focuses
items: The four naval focuses are gone: Maritime, Naval, Littoral Fleet and Highseas Fleet. Naval bonuses now sit inside the focuses that share their idea (quality, quantity, offense, defense, maneuver, logistics and so on), mostly on the same advance as the matching army bonus

Renaissance: new Standing Forces replaces Maritime. Finest of Horses (moved from Levy): Heavy and Light Cavalry Power +5%, Heavy and Light Cavalry Maintenance Cost −5%. Royal Arsenals: Recruitment Speed +25%, Ship-building Speed +25%. Drilled Regulars: Monthly Experience Gain +25%. Household Troops: Army Morale +0.25, Navy Morale +0.25. Regular Pay: Army and Navy Maintenance Efficiency +5%. Improved Rams (moved from Maritime): Galley Power +15%, Galley Maintenance Cost −10%
Levy: new Common Foot replaces Finest of Horses, Heavy and Light Infantry Power +10%, since levies are mostly infantry. Battlefield Commissions adds Navy Tradition from Battles +100%

Mercenary: Privateers (Can Hire Privateers) moves here from Maritime and replaces Ideas of Tolerance, whose Tolerance of Heretical Beliefs and Tolerance of Heathen Beliefs +0.5 move into Benefits for Mercenaries. Organized Mercenary Payments adds Cost of Hiring Privateers −20%. Glorious Arms adds Prestige from Naval Battles +100%. Privateers' Anti-Piracy Warfare +25% moves to Defense

Discovery: new Leadership replaces Naval. Formalized Officer Corps (moved from Quality): Army Initiative +25%, new Navy Initiative +50%. Well-Trained Forces (moved from Quality): Monthly Army Tradition +0.1 → +0.2, new Monthly Navy Tradition +0.2, new Army and Navy Tradition Decay −0.1%; its cost cuts move to Administrative Leadership. Administrative Leadership returns: Hire Advisor Cost −25%, Train General and Train Admiral Cost −25% → −40%. Military Academies: Increased General and Admiral Ability +40. Drill Sergeants (moved from Quality): Monthly Experience Gain +50%, Monthly Experience Decay −1%. Aides-de-Camp: Correct Section Chance +30%

Quality: Naval Drill (moved from Naval): Navy Morale +10%. New Hardened Ranks: Military Tactics +0.1, Naval Damage Taken −10%. New Elite Companies, a trade-off: Heavy and Light Cavalry Power +10% and Heavy Ship Power +15%, but Heavy Cavalry and Heavy Ship Maintenance Cost +5%

Quantity: Rapid Reinforcement adds Possible Frontage +10%. Camp Followers takes over Supply Trains' Unit Food Consumption −10% (Supply Trains removed). The Old and Infirm adds Navy Maintenance Efficiency +10%. Deep Reserves adds Navy Repair Efficiency +20%. Grand Navy (moved from Naval) now gives Galley, Heavy Ship and Light Ship Build Cost −15% (was Navy Maintenance Efficiency +10%, Navy Attrition −25%). Grand Army adds Sailors +15%

Reformation: new Balanced replaces Littoral Fleet, half of Offense and half of Defense. Military Engineers: Siege Ability +10%, Fort Defense +10%. Garrison Artillery: Artillery Power +5%, Garrison Size +10%. Coastal Squadrons: Blockade Efficiency +25%, Combat Outside Own Coasts +5%. Seasoned Campaigners: Army and Navy Attrition −10%. Ready Reserves: Army Reinforcement and Navy Repair Efficiency +10%. Steady Resolve: Maximum War Exhaustion +2

Offense: Engineer Corps adds Blockade Efficiency +25%. Defense: Defensive Mentality adds Combat Outside Own Coasts +10% (despite the in-game name, the game applies it in sea zones next to your own land); Fortification Logistics adds Anti-Piracy Warfare Modifier +25%

Absolutism: new Firepower replaces Highseas Fleet. Volley Fire: Light Infantry Power +5%, Naval Damage Done +10%. Line of Battle: Heavy Infantry Power +5%, Heavy Ship Power +10%. Horse Artillery: Artillery Power +10%. Paper Cartridges: Combat Speed +10%. Frigates: Light Ship Power +15%, Light Ship Build Cost −20%. Prize Crews: Ship Capture Chance +5%
Maneuver: Forced March adds Navy Movement Speed +10%. Bold Maneuvers adds Army Disembark Speed +25%. Offensive Army adds Navy Morale Recovery Speed +2%

Logistics: Improved Foraging adds Navy Attrition −20%. Improved Logistics adds Naval Range +20%. Logistics Corps adds Transport Power +25%. Trained Reserves adds Ship Repair Speed at Sea +2.5%. Bug fix, Enduring Hardships: Army Morale Attrition Cost −25% → −0.25%. The base is only 1%, so the old value removed morale loss from attrition entirely instead of cutting it by a quarter

Revolutions, Voluntary Service: Disciplined Drills adds Navy Morale +10%; Mission Command adds Navy Initiative +25%. Conscription: Mass Army adds Sailors +20%; National Conscripts adds Ship-building Speed +25%; Nationalistic Enthusiasm adds Navy Maintenance Efficiency +10%; The Young can Serve adds Navy Repair Efficiency +10%. Insurrection: Last Stand adds Combat Outside Own Coasts +10%

title: Expansion: colonial migration kept
items: Land of Opportunity: Monthly Colonial Migration +25% → +50% (takes over the +25% from the removed Additional Colonists)

title: Expansion: faster ocean crossings
items: Additional Colonists (Monthly Colonial Migration +25%) replaced by the new Trade Winds: Navy Movement Speed +10%

title: Quantity: more manpower
items: Grand Army: Manpower +10% → +15%

title: Logistics: less food for the army
items: Prepared Camps: new Unit Food Consumption -15% (Supply Limit +10% kept)

title: Quality and Naval trimmed to six, more tactics at sea
items: Quality: Administrative Leadership removed; its Hire Advisor Cost -25%, Train General Cost -25% and Train Admiral Cost -25% moved into Well-Trained Forces (Monthly Army Tradition +0.1 kept)
Naval: Copper Bottoms removed; its Navy Attrition -25% moved into Grand Navy (Navy Maintenance Efficiency +10% kept)
Tactics from Across the Seas: Military Tactics +0.1 → +0.2

title: Levy trimmed to six, Voluntary Service back to six
items: Levy: Feudal Obligations removed; its Levy Recovery +10% moved into Enforced Service (now Levy Size +10%, Levy Recovery +10%)
Voluntary Service: new Mission Command, Army Initiative +10%

title: Influence: more subject income
items: Tribute System: Subject Income +2.5% → +5%

title: Influence: Absorbing Vassals
items: Tribute System: Loyalty of Subjects +5 → +10
Additional Loyalist Recruitment (Loyalty of Subjects +5) replaced by the new Absorbing Vassals: Speed of Annexation +20%

title: Sabotage Fort: cooldown per victim
items: A sabotaged country can't be targeted again by anyone for 2 years, on top of the 2-year cooldown for the user

title: Fort limit, mercenary tactics, logistics distance
items: Defense, Fortified Cities: Fort Limit +8 → +3 (the +10% Fort Limit Modifier is unchanged)
Mercenary, Glorious Arms: now also Military Tactics +0.1
Logistics, Improved Logistics: Logistics Distance +10% → +20%

title: Steal Technology no longer hurts the target
items: The stealer still gains 20% of the target's research progress; the target no longer loses 10% of its own

title: Lesser Infiltration is now clearly weaker
items: Lesser Infiltration (Renaissance tree): 25 → 50 spy network, 12 → 3 months. Infiltrate Administration from the Espionage focus costs the same and lasts 24 months

title: Espionage comes earlier
items: Espionage moves to the Age of Discovery and Diplomatic to the Age of Absolutism (they swapped places)

title: Military branch tuning
items: Levy, Designated Instruction: Levy Combat Efficiency +10% → +30%
Finest of Horses moves from Voluntary Service (Age of Revolutions) to Levy (Age of Renaissance), with Heavy and Light Cavalry Power +10% → +5%
Quality, Drill Sergeants: now also Monthly Experience Decay −1%
Quality: new advance Strict Discipline, Discipline +5%
Naval: new advance Tactics from Across the Seas, Military Tactics +0.1

title: Sabotage Fort: 2-year cooldown
items: Sabotage Fort cooldown for the user: 5 → 2 years

title: Espionage: Sabotage Fort advance
items: Efficient Spies is replaced by the new Sabotage Fort advance, which only unlocks the Sabotage Fort action
Its Spy Network Construction +50% moves to Vetting, the first Espionage advance

title: Sabotage Fort joins the Espionage focus
items: Sabotage Fort can only be unlocked through the Espionage focus
It can only target countries you are at war with, with a 5-year cooldown
